premise: Speedy Sandpiper races slow Hermit Crab and Turtle to the rock pool, but keeps stopping for snacks; the slow two arrive first, chatting, and Sandpiper says he won the most snacks.
inspiration: Aesop's tortoise and hare with three runners and no gloating: the slow ones arrive together, and the fast one has his own kind of prize.
lesson: Slow and steady gets there, and everyone has their own win.

en-US.title: The Slow Race
en-US.text: [excited] A race to the rock pool! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Sandpiper hopped from foot to foot. I'm the fastest! {hermit-crab:enter} Hermit Crab sighed. {hermit-crab:face sad} I'm very slow. {turtle:enter} [slowly] And I'm… even… slower, said Turtle. {turtle:face happy} Ready, steady… GO! {sandpiper:go to shore by run} Zip! Off ran Sandpiper. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Hermit Crab and Turtle set off, step… by step… [short pause] But halfway there, Sandpiper spotted something tasty. {sandpiper:live} Peck, peck, peck! Then something else. {sandpiper:hop} Peck, peck! Hermit Crab and Turtle just kept going, chatting all the way. {hermit-crab:face happy} And who reached the pool first? [gasps] Hermit Crab and Turtle, together! {hermit-crab:live} Hermit Crab was so surprised he popped into his shell, and peeked out again. {turtle:live} Turtle tucked her head in, and peeked out too, smiling. [laughs] At last, {sandpiper:go to pool by run} along came Sandpiper, last of all. I lost, he said, {sandpiper:hop x2} but I won the most snacks! {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}

es-ES.title: La carrera lenta
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Una carrera hasta la charca! {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:face happy} Correlimos saltaba de una pata a otra. ¡Yo soy el más rápido! {hermit-crab:enter} Cangrejo Ermitaño suspiró. {hermit-crab:face sad} Yo soy muy lento. {turtle:enter} [slowly] Y yo… todavía… más lenta, dijo Tortuga. {turtle:face happy} Preparados, listos… ¡YA! {sandpiper:go to shore by run} ¡Zas! Allá fue Correlimos. {hermit-crab:go to pool} {turtle:go to pool} Ermitaño y Tortuga salieron, paso… a paso… [short pause] Pero a medio camino, Correlimos vio algo rico. {sandpiper:live} ¡Pic, pic, pic! Luego otra cosa. {sandpiper:hop} ¡Pic, pic! Ermitaño y Tortuga siguieron andando, charlando todo el rato. {hermit-crab:face happy} ¿Y quién llegó primero a la charca? [gasps] ¡Ermitaño y Tortuga, a la vez! {hermit-crab:live} Ermitaño se sorprendió tanto que se metió en su concha, y volvió a asomarse. {turtle:live} Tortuga escondió la cabeza, y también se asomó, sonriendo. [laughs] Por fin, {sandpiper:go to pool by run} llegó Correlimos, el último. He perdido, dijo, {sandpiper:hop x2} ¡pero he ganado más meriendas! {hermit-crab:hearts} {turtle:hearts}
